content.text:
The UN operator's own history page gives the opening year, but I found no separate opening date or size for the data centre. It is described only as attached to the UNOV secretariat, so the values below are for the whole Vienna International Centre campus.

**Opening year:** The UN's own history page places the inauguration of the complex on 23 August 1979

citations.cited_text: The VIC was inaugurated on 23 August 1979.
citations.title: History of the Vienna International Centre - United Nations

content.text: The VIC was inaugurated on 23 August 1979.
**Size:** The facility manager IAKW-AG reports a combined floor space for the complex. Its site describes

citations.cited_text: Following the transfer of the building to the United Nations in 1979, IAKW-AG retained responsibility for management, maintenance and utility services...
citations.title: About

content.text: eight buildings with a combined floor space of 325,000m²
. This is the gross building figure I selected. Other sources disagree: Wikipedia gives a total floor area of 230,000 m²

citations.cited_text: Six Y-shaped office towers surround a cylindrical conference building for a total floor area of 230,000 square metres.
citations.title: Vienna International Centre

content.text: for a total floor area of 230,000 square metres
. The UN's own page instead gives a campus footprint of 180,000 m², stating that

citations.cited_text: The VIC complex, which covers an area of 180,000 m², has extraterritorial status.
citations.title: History of the Vienna International Centre - United Nations

content.text: the VIC complex covers an area of 180,000 m²

, which is a land-area figure rather than floor area. Because the sources conflict, match confidence is medium.

**Data centre:** The Austrian foreign ministry notes that

citations.cited_text: A sophisticated data centre is attached to the secretariat.
citations.title: The Vienna International Centre (VIC)

content.text: a sophisticated data centre is attached to the secretariat.

No opening date or size for that data centre itself was found.
